meta.title: Clozer · Know who reads your documents, follow up at the right time
meta.description: Quotes, invoices, decks, technical docs: send a tracked link instead of an attachment. Clozer sees which pages get read, tells you who to follow up with, and writes the follow-up.
meta.shortDescription: Quotes, invoices, decks: send a tracked link. Clozer tells you who to follow up with and writes the follow-up.
meta.ogHeadline: See where your document heats up.

hero.title: Know who's reading your proposal. Follow up <hot>at the right time</hot>.
hero.lead: For B2B sales reps and their managers. Send a Clozer link instead of the PDF: see who opens it, what they read and who they forward it to. Clozer drafts the follow-up.

silence.title: You hit send. Then, silence.
silence.body: The document is out. Did they open it? Make it to pricing? Forward it to the decision-maker? So you follow up blind: too early and you're a pest, too late and they've signed with someone else.

table.caption: What you know after sending: with a PDF attachment, and with a Clozer link (example values).

reply.label: Can they reply?
reply.pdf: By email, if they think of it
reply.link: They approve or book a call in the document

send.title: Two ways to send. Nothing to learn.

link.name: The link
link.body: Upload the document and your link is ready in a second. Paste it wherever you already talk to clients: email, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, text. Your client opens it in the browser, on desktop or phone, with nothing to install.

mail.name: From Gmail or Outlook
mail.body: Attach your PDF like you always do. When you hit send, the extension swaps it for a Clozer link, then pings you at the top of your inbox when it gets read. The Chrome extension works in Gmail and in Outlook on the web; for desktop Outlook, your Microsoft 365 admin adds the add-in.

steps.title: Three steps. Nothing to install to get started.

upload.title: Drop your proposal.
upload.body: A PDF, a web page (Notion, Google Slides, Figma…) or a 3-minute video pitch.
upload.alt: Clozer screen: the area to drop a PDF, and the field to paste a web page link.

send.title: Send the link.
send.body: Paste it into your email, or let the Gmail and Outlook extension swap the attachment. One link per prospect.
send.alt: Clozer screen: the link is ready for Sarah Collins, with Copy link and Send by email buttons.

followUp.title: Approve the follow-up.
followUp.body: Clozer writes it and picks the time. You read it, you send it.
followUp.alt: Clozer screen: a follow-up written after a pricing read, suggested for 9 AM the next day, waiting for Approve.

steps.guided: After you sign up, a guided tour walks you through a first test link.

followUps.title: Clozer drafts the <nowrap>follow-up</nowrap>. You approve it.
followUps.body: Every morning, the list of prospects to follow up with. For each one, a message based on what they read, with the day and time to send it in their time zone.

brief.title: The morning brief
brief.body: An email every working day, at the hour you choose: who to follow up with, who answered, which links are about to expire.

stuck.title: A follow-up that answers what's holding them back
stuck.body: The message starts from what the prospect read and from your offer. It lands on a working day, during office hours, in the prospect's time zone.

approve.title: Approved in one click, or sent on its own
approve.body: Switch to automatic mode and simple follow-ups go out without you, like a reminder or an offer to talk.

delicate.title: Delicate cases wait for you
delicate.body: A prospect who wrote to you, a reader who came through a forward, a link never opened. Their follow-up waits for your approval, even in automatic mode.

followUps.alt: Clozer's Today board: 2 hot prospects, Northwind and Acme, each with a follow-up ready to approve, and Atelier Morel reading at a warm pace.

prospect.title: Your prospect moves forward without waiting on you.
prospect.body: It all happens inside the document. They approve, ask for a change or book a call, and you hear about it right away.

approve.title: Approve or ask for a change
approve.body: "Accept & sign" sits at the end of the document. If they want something changed, they write two lines without digging up your email.

book.title: Book a call
book.body: Your Calendly or Cal.com page opens inside the document. As soon as they book, automatic follow-ups stop.

ask.title: Ask a question, or leave a voice note
ask.body: The assistant answers from your proposal and hands over to you when it doesn't know. On any page, they can also leave a one-minute voice note, transcribed for you.

language.title: Read it in their language
language.body: English, French, Spanish, German, Italian or Portuguese: the PDF is translated with its layout intact.

prospect.actionsAlt: Proposal open on a phone, pricing page: at the bottom, Accept & sign, Book a meeting, Request a change, a voice note and forwarding; at the top, a choice of six languages.
prospect.changeAlt: The prospect asks for a change from inside the proposal: "Could we pay in three instalments? And start the design in November?"

trust.title: Track the deal, not the person.
trust.body: Your prospects are your future customers. Heat is measured on pages, never on people, and your follow-up still reads like it came from a thoughtful salesperson.
trust.informed: The prospect is told, right on the page, what the sender can see.
trust.discreet: A follow-up never lets on that you're tracking what they read.
trust.limit: Three follow-ups per contact per month, max, and never right after a read.
trust.unsubscribe: An unsubscribe link in every follow-up. IP addresses are never stored in the clear.

who.title: One tool, from solo shop to sales team.
who.beta: Clozer is in beta: everything is unlocked, no credit card required. If a paid plan comes along, you'll hear about it first.

solo.name: Solo
solo.body: Quotes, invoices, decks: one link per client, follow-ups written for you. Sign in with Google or your email and send your first link in minutes.

team.name: Team
team.who: Sales reps at small and midsize companies, with a manager.
team.body: Invite your team: everyone tracks their own deals, and the manager sees the full picture in the Team view. Alerts by email, Slack, Chrome or Outlook.

enterprise.name: Enterprise
enterprise.body: Rolling out across several teams, or have security or integration requirements? We'll look at your setup together before opening access.

included.formats: PDFs, web pages and video pitches
included.deals: Deal reads, follow-ups drafted for you
included.replies: Meetings, assistant and voice notes from prospects

informed.q: Does the prospect know their reading is tracked?
informed.a: Yes. A clear notice sits on the document page, with a link to our privacy policy. Follow-ups, on the other hand, stay natural: they never mention a specific page or reading time.

auto.q: Do follow-ups go out on their own?
auto.a: By default, Clozer writes the follow-up and suggests the day and time to send it; you review it and approve in one click. Later on, you can let it send the simple ones by itself when it's confident. The tricky cases (an objection, a question from the prospect) always wait for you.

documents.a: Anything you send to a client or prospect. Any PDF: quote, invoice, proposal, deck, technical document, contract, résumé, brochure, case study. Clozer recognizes the type and shows you how it was read, page by page. A web page (Notion, Loom, Figma, Google Slides, Webflow…): opens and time spent, plus a reader view if the site won't display inside Clozer. A video pitch recorded in Clozer, up to three minutes: you know how far they watched.

ownOpens.q: Do my own opens skew the numbers?
ownOpens.a: No. When you open your own links while signed in to Clozer, the read is ignored. Bots are filtered out too.

install.q: Do I need to install anything?
install.a: No. Sign in with Google or your email, no password, copy the link, and your client reads it in their browser, on desktop or phone. The Gmail and Outlook extension is a handy shortcut, not a requirement.

extension.q: How do I install the Gmail and Outlook extension?
extension.a: Install “Clozer” from the Chrome Web Store: it works in Gmail and in Outlook on the web. For desktop Outlook on Windows or Mac, your company's Microsoft 365 admin adds the add-in for the whole team; the steps are on the Support page.

replies.q: Can the prospect get back to me?
replies.a: Yes, without leaving the document. They can accept the proposal or ask for a change, book a meeting on your calendar (Calendly, Cal.com…), ask the assistant, which answers from your offer when you're not around, or leave a voice note on a page. You get all of it, with the transcript.
